title: CBIA - Add Developer Tool Compatibility Matrix to Cardano Developers Portal

ms.promise:
Project kick-off and interaction with stakeholders.
Data structures and Technical changes to Developer portal.
ms.criteria:
This project is in contact with Cardano Foundation Dev Portal maintainers and some Dev Portal tooling authors (CBIA members included) in order to provide initial indication of the compatibility of their tool with others on the ecosystem.
Data structures and Technical changes to Developer portal (plus documentation) enable the portal to gather the relationships and compatibility between different tools. This will be done through attributes, such as Protocol version compatibility, that will be recorded as a ‘Trait’ of each component.
ms.report:
The "Outputs", “Acceptance Criteria" and "Evidence of Milestone Completion" for this Milestone are all structured having firstly a “Stakeholders” side, and secondly a “Technical” side.
Regarding the Stakeholders side of this milestone, we confirm we are now in contact with the Cardano Foundation Dev Portal maintainers, having chatted with Tommy (CF Community Team) and met with Bora Oben (Developer Advocate), who is in charge of overseeing changes to this portal.
We have also engaged with some Dev Portal tooling authors via a GitHub issue on the portal’s repository and gathered initial indication of the compatibility of their tool with others from some CBIA members.
Further details and evidence can be found via the new Projects section of our website at https://cbia.io/#projects by clicking "Project updates page".

Regarding the Technical side of this milestone, we have established a Data structure to enable the portal to gather the relationships and compatibility between different tools.
To prove this, we have built an initial version of the code that will display these relationships and compatibility within the portal.
Detailing for both the Data structure and Technical changes to the Developer portal can be seen at https://github.com/CardanoBlockchainInfraAlliance/developer-portal#technical-updates

ms.promise: Dependency Graph visualization research and implementation
ms.criteria: Our Fork of the Dev portal will render one Dependency Graph visualization which represents dependency/compatibility across Cardano tools recorded on the Dev Portal. Although it is just one main graph, it enabling to select each single item/tool to highlight and foresee downstream impacts on dependant tools.
